name: @tedix/skill-runtime
description: Runs executable skills, automations, and one-off flows in per-run sandboxed Workers on a durable engine.

scripts.dev: bun run clear-port && bun ../../scripts/dev-local.ts -- vp dev
scripts.deploy:production: bun run types && vp build --mode production && cf deploy --mode production --prebuilt --message ${GIT_SHA:-${GITHUB_SHA:-unknown}}
scripts.test:run: bun run test:unit && bun run test:workerd
